paragraphs.text: Wolverine is a red and green creature type used for cards depicting burrowing carnivorous mammals of northern forest regions.

Wolverines (Gulo gulo) are related to the weasel (not to the Wolf ) and have a heavyset body, short legs, dark fur, and a bushy tail. All Wolverines are mechanically hostile to being blocked, getting either First Strike or a stat boost.
The first creature to bear the type was Grizzled Wolverine in Ice Age , though Wolverine Pack from Legends was later issued errata to become a Wolverine instead of Wolverine Pack .
One of the minor calamity beasts on Bloomburrow is the Hivespine Wolverine which is an elemental wolverine that is covered in beehives.

During the Ice Age , grizzled wolverines and karplusan wolverines were known to inhabit Balduvia . Lovisa Coldeyes once said the Karplusan wolverines are hard to train, but fortunately already know how to kill.

Otaria is home to a type of wolverine beast called the Spurred Wolverine. It has various spurred spikes coming out of its neck. Goblins once tried to pick their nose around the beast but learned after a few painful experiences.
Some wolverines travel in packs around the plane.
Eldraine is home to the aggressive bloodhaze wolverine.

The Spelleater Wolverine inhabits Ikoria. It is seemingly able to absorb the power of spells, causing it to glow and crackle with energy. Taelya commented that she was scared of them despite their size.
During the Phyrexian Invasion of the Multiverse , the War-Trained Slasher helped fight against the Phyrexians . It is a large dinosaur wolverine with blue crystals growing over its back.
Mercadia has wolverines in its deepwoods. However, the jhovalls are known to deplete their food sources, and the Mercadians are eroding their home.
Rath was home to Rabid Wolverines, which seemingly traveled in packs.
Thunder Junction is inhabited by Irascible Wolverines, which will attack carriages and seem to have an affinity for fire.
